tool.name: SynCraft
tool.description: Multi-step retrosynthesis planning for drug discovery

param.name: smiles
param.label: Target molecule SMILES
param.help: SMILES string of the target molecule to synthesize

param.name: top_k
param.label: Top K routes
param.help: Number of top synthesis routes to return

param.name: expansion_topk
param.label: Expansion Top K
param.help: Number of candidate reactions to consider at each step

tool.help:
**SynCraft: Multi-Step Retrosynthesis Planning**
SynCraft uses AI to plan chemical synthesis routes for drug molecules.
**Input:** - SMILES string of the target molecule
**Output:** - JSON file containing ranked synthesis routes with: - Step-by-step reactions - Reaction conditions - Starting materials - Confidence scores
**Example SMILES:** - Aspirin: CC(=O)OC1=CC=CC=C1C(=O)O - Ibuprofen: CC(C)CC1=CC=C(C=C1)C(C)C(=O)O
**Citation:** SynCraft: AI-Driven Retrosynthesis for Drug Discovery (2024)
